Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a long kite that he loved to play with. One sunny day, he went to play with his kite in the park.
While he was playing, a big wind came and blew the kite far from Tim. The wind blew and blew, but the kite went too far for him. He could not find it. Tim felt sad because he missed his kite.
Then, something unexpected happened. A kind bird saw Tim and flew to him. The bird took the kite with its beak! Tim was so happy.
